name: WooCommerce
title: woocommerce.com
shortDescription: WooCommerce is a flexible ecommerce platform built on WordPress, allowing users to create unique online stores. It is designed for small to large-sized online merchants using WordPress. The platform enables users to customize their store from payments and shipping to marketing and accounting, providing a comprehensive solution for growing their business online.
pros: Large selection of extensions and themes
cons: Costs can accumulate with many extensions

aiSuggestedAlternatives.reason: Provides extensive customization and scalability options.
